label: No placebo
rationale: This is a six-arm pragmatic randomized implementation trial comparing behavioral nudges against a generic Best Practice Alert and no nudge, not an inactive drug placebo. The control condition is explicitly usual care/generic BPA, and the other arms are clinician or patient nudges, so no placebo comparator is described.
